tldr: The Moon through the 4th house sensitizes home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When the Moon moves through your 4th house, it makes you more sensitive to home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

A need, mood, habit, or private reaction may become harder to ignore. It can help you read what you need before the feeling gets louder.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for treating a temporary mood as the whole truth. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

The Moon moves through this house for a few days. Treat the feeling as information. Give it a grounded place to land before you react from it.
